what_happened: During research reproduction of the V7 untracking scenario, a Bash tool call's leading 'cd $scratchdir' silently failed (scratchpad dir is outside the main working directories, so cd state does not persist across tool calls per the harness contract) and the remaining shell commands in that same call ran against the real repo's cwd instead, writing 'sub/' over the real .gitignore and committing it as 54e80b7fe ('add gitignore for sub'). Caught immediately via git log/git show, fixed by restoring .gitignore from the prior commit and committing the restoration via git-commit-scoped.sh (239f0217e), scoped to .gitignore only. No other files were affected. Immediate git log/git show inspection after the scratch-repo bash call caught the damage before it compounded; git-commit-scoped.sh's single-file pathspec made the corrective commit trivial to scope correctly.
